title: Kusanagi Nene — Into A Magical Dress〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wedding Hall

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Oh! Hello, Ms. Nozaki!

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: Hello. This is our first time meeting since the Phoenix Bridal Fair, yes? I really need to thank you again for doing what you did!

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: I asked you to meet with me today so that I can give you the photos of you in your dress and this mini album of photos from the show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? A mini album?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'd only heard that I'd be getting some pictures of me in my dress, but...)

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: I had our photographer take some snapshots of the show for us. And there were so many wonderful photos that I couldn't just let them sit in the archives.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: So, as a little gift, I've decided to give copies of them to the entire cast.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, wow...
This is really cute. It looks like a children's fantasy storybook.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: Hehe. It's a story involving angels, so I did my best to come up with a suitable design.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm a little embarrassed, but I think I'll take a look...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Wow, these were definitely taken by a pro...
I mean, they did such a good job of capturing our expressions and each scene as a whole.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I honestly can't believe how well these turned out.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like them so much.

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: That reminds me. Will you be seeing Ms. Hanasato again anytime soon?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... I have her contact information if that helps...

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line:
I actually have a mini album for her as well.
Would you mind handing that and her dress photos to her the next time you get a chance?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Nozaki
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure it would mean much more to her to get them from her friend.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her friend...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we both go get changed and head home?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, umm... Together?
I probably have to go help clean up and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's okay! I can wait!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, Ms. Nozaki.
I'll take those over to Hanasato for you.
A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(It's almost time...
I'm starting to get nervous.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I actually brought that mini album and all the photos with me, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, how many times have I done this now? I've checked my bag like five times just since I got here...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Seriously, why am I this anxious?
All I'm doing is handing this over to her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Hanasato and I are f-friends...
There's no reason for me to feel this way...)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Nene!
Sorry for cutting it so close.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that's okay!
I also just got here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Actually, I got here forty minutes ago...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, sorry for calling you out like this. You had work today, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, but I still want to hang out as much as I can with my friends, so thanks for inviting me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, before I forget, lemme give you these. These are pictures of you in your dress, and this is the mini album of photos from the show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, thanks!
I've been looking forward to them ever since you told me about this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa! This photographer's a total pro...!
I look like a star on stage!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This photographer did a good job, but so did you, Hanasato. It's so amazing what idols can do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Y-You think so?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let me take this opportunity to thank you again for jumping in to help with the show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for giving me such an amazing opportunity!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of shows, you and your troupe aren't performing at PXL right now, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we're currently in the middle of visiting different troupes and training with them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa, like wandering warriors?!
That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I feel like being an idol who appears on TV is a lot more impressive, personally...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, which troupes have you guys been visiting? Can you tell me?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which troupes? Yeah, I can tell you that much...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! Where was your first stop?
I'm curious what you guys practice and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. Slow down. I can't answer all of that at once.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry!
I didn't mean to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Then, lemme start with what that troupe was like.
